description: This file implements the support functions for paging slot scheduling in a 5G NR context, including configuration parsing, slot calculations, and paging slot determination based on 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: paging_slot_helper
classes.description: Helper class for determining paging slots based on cell configuration and search space parameters.

methods.name: paging_slot_helper::paging_slot_helper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes paging slot helper based on cell configuration, parsing search space and coreset info.

methods.name: paging_slot_helper::is_paging_slot
methods.description: Determines if a given slot and symbol index correspond to a paging slot.

methods.name: paging_slot_helper::is_paging_slot_in_search_space_id_gt_0
methods.description: Checks if a slot is a paging slot when search space ID is greater than zero, based on periodicity and beam info.

methods.name: paging_slot_helper::is_paging_slot_in_search_space0
methods.description: Checks if a slot is a paging slot when search space ID is zero, based on periodicity and symbol position.

methods.name: paging_slot_helper::precompute_type2_pdcch_slots
methods.description: Precomputes PDCCH monitoring occasions for paging based on search space configuration and subcarrier spacing.
